title: Carbon leaves a fuel
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Aerobic cellular respiration breaks down glucose and releases its carbon as carbon dioxide. Oxygen is consumed and water and ATP are also produced; the picture tracks carbon only.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain respiration from glucose to carbon dioxide in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: During aerobic cellular respiration, carbon atoms from glucose can leave a cell in which product? Aerobic cellular respiration breaks down glucose and releases its carbon as carbon dioxide. Oxygen is consumed and water and ATP are also produced; the picture tracks carbon only.
